create.name: Aaravindha Himadra
create.bio:
Aaravindha Himadra is an American-born spiritual teacher and author who teaches within what he calls the Amartya tradition, a Himalayan lineage of mystics. In the summer of 2006 he made a hard trek deep into the Himalayas to a hidden valley, where he stayed among the masters of this lineage and received an initiation as one of its teachers. He tells the story of that journey, and shares some of the lineage's teachings, in his book Immortal Self, which has also come out in German as Das Tal der unsterblichen Meister.

He has been guiding students for several decades, working with individuals as well as small and large groups. His approach combines meditation practices, which mentors in his community pass on to newcomers according to their needs, with teachings on self-knowledge, compassion and devotion, and he also draws on modern science. The aim he describes is to help people let go of doubt and fear, recognise their true nature and live out their own purpose. He teaches through seminars and retreats online and in person, including multi-day satsangs in Switzerland, and through a free online library of articles, recorded satsangs and podcasts, along with a forum in which he answers questions sent in by students.
